title: Sketch curve - old version
summary: The users can sketch a curve (thick grey line). The resulting point cloud is converted by the Visvalingam algorithm to a list consisting of a start point and an end point, as well as 6 internal point. Finally, these 8 points are interpolated by a cardinal spline curve.
